research_question: Does the already-frozen H003 48/192 long-flat rule provide a reproducible defensive/risk-adjusted benefit when prior-exposed retrospective diagnostics are separated from genuinely post-preregistration prospective evidence?

forbidden_claims: independent historical replication on BTCUSDT or ETHUSDT

frozen_strategy.decision_rule: completed bar t; raw sign(MA48-MA192); negative maps to FLAT; one-bar shift so position decided at t owns t->t+1 return

activation_boundary.reason: The scientific follow-up design is frozen, but this preregistration grants no generic strategy-test or paper-shadow execution authority. A separate Git-backed activation/reopen must authorize the exact historical diagnostic matrix and prospective recorder after merge.

prior_exposed_retrospective_diagnostic.role: supplementary robustness diagnostic and possible falsifying evidence only; it cannot create confirmatory support

input_identity_contract.materialization_rule: Materialize exactly from each frozen history_start through historical_end inclusive, then require exact start, end, expected_rows, and raw_sha256 before strategy execution. If a longer append-only raw file is used as a source, hash and verify the exact first expected_rows CSV rows plus header and require the last prefix timestamp to equal historical_end and the prefix SHA256 to equal raw_sha256.

prospective_panel.activation_rule: After this preregistration is merged to master and a separate activation/reopen is canonical, create a prospective activation artifact from Git metadata only. All three assets share one prospective origin equal to the next whole UTC hour strictly after the activation commit timestamp; the preregistration itself may not start recording.
prospective_panel.return_ownership_rule: Pre-origin closes may initialize MA48/MA192 state only. No pre-origin return or transition cost may enter prospective metrics. A prospective return is owned only when its ending bar timestamp is strictly greater than the prospective origin.

combined_adjudication.DEFENSIVE_REPLICATION_SUPPORTED: after separate activation, prospective_panel primary gate passes AND prior_exposed_retrospective_diagnostic hurdle passes; historical diagnostic is supplementary and cannot create this verdict by itself
combined_adjudication.FRAGILE_OR_UNPROVEN: after separate activation, prospective_panel passes but the prior-exposed diagnostic hurdle fails, or prospective regime coverage is inconclusive
combined_adjudication.FALSIFIED: after separate activation, prospective_panel reaches maturity with sufficient regime coverage and fails its primary success gate
combined_adjudication.BLOCKED_BY_INPUT_OR_INTEGRITY: any frozen input, provenance, continuity, receipt, implementation, acquisition, or activation identity check fails
combined_adjudication.downstream_authority_after_any_verdict: NONE; any Qnty/QntySpot paper or live canary requires a separate explicit authorization
